correctness.rationale: For free/free N>=3 constant-spring chain, T=4I-L_N is positive definite. The generalized eigenvalue count above E=4 equals positive inertia of -T+4delta P, hence of the 2x2 Green compression. Explicit inverse ((-1)^(i+j)(2min(i,j)-1)(2(N-max(i,j))+1)/(4N)) satisfies the boundary equations; independently checked T*G=I and full inertia vs rank-two predictions for all N=3..10, site pairs and three contrasts. Rayleigh vector (1,-1) bounds beta_-<=N/8, equality iff symmetric quarter sites with N=2 mod 4, and nearest-integer placement gives 2N/(N^2-4) upper onset. Strict > excludes edge modes; both thresholds <1 by endpoint inertia.
